features.description: Backend health watchdog periodically checks all backends and updates their status in a shared state file or DB table
validation_steps: Assert output is at least 1 showing periodic health monitoring
features.notes: Instead of checking health per-request, run a background thread that pings backends every 30s and writes status. Tasks read status before dispatching.

features.description: huginn health command shows real-time status of all backends with latency, loaded models, and active task count
validation_steps: Assert exit code 0 and stdout contains usage information
features.notes: Quick operational check before kicking off batch work. Shows: backend name, reachable, latency, models loaded, tasks currently running.

features.description: Automatic task pause when all backends for a task's remaining stages become unreachable — task enters 'paused' state instead of failing
validation_steps: Assert output is at least 1 showing automatic pause on backend loss
features.notes: Mac sleeps → tasks hitting mac pause instead of fail. When mac wakes, paused tasks auto-resume. Requires health watchdog (F117).

features.description: Stale task reaper runs on huginn startup and marks old running/queued tasks as interrupted if their process is dead
validation_steps: Assert output is at least 1 showing startup stale task detection
features.notes: Currently stale detection happens lazily on huginn tasks/status. Should also run on any huginn command so the DB is always consistent.
